import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut


def dimuon_mask(events, params, **kwargs):
    muons = events.MuonGood

    # sort by pT (descending) so index 0/1 are the leading/subleading muons
    sort_idx = ak.argsort(muons.pt, axis=1, ascending=False)
    muons = muons[sort_idx]

    has_two_muons = ak.num(muons, axis=1) >= 2

    padded = ak.pad_none(muons, 2, axis=1)
    leading = padded[:, 0]
    subleading = padded[:, 1]

    pt_threshold = params["pt"]
    pt_cut = (leading.pt > pt_threshold) & (subleading.pt > pt_threshold)
    opposite_charge = (leading.charge * subleading.charge) < 0

    mask = has_two_muons & pt_cut & opposite_charge
    return ak.fill_none(mask, False)
